reuse.why: Reuses the existing building blocks (ensureBankAccountIsNotLinked, link.findOrCreateBank, bankSync.syncAccount, handleSyncResponse, post/BankSyncError), but the tree has no shared link-account or download-transactions helper and the change does not create one, so the provider flow is rewritten again.

duplication.why: linkFintegraAccount is a near-verbatim copy of linkAkahuAccount (upgrade-or-insert, payee insert, sync, sync-event) and downloadFintegraTransactions copies downloadAkahuTransactions, adding a sixth copy of each provider pattern.

placement.why: Link handler, download function, server URL and provider list go where the tree puts them, but SyncServerFintegraAccount is added to types/models/simplefin.ts instead of its own fintegra.ts like every other provider type.

scope.why: Only the edits needed for the new provider: handler registration, download branch, server path, provider id and account type.

maintainability.why: Consistent with the existing per-provider copies so easy to follow, but it extends the copy-paste pattern (any change to linking or downloading must now be made in six places) and the misplaced type adds confusion.

bypasses_abstraction.where: No shared link/download abstraction exists in the tree; the change uses the existing primitives (ensureBankAccountIsNotLinked, findOrCreateBank, syncAccount, handleSyncResponse) rather than going around them.

disguised_duplication.where: linkFintegraAccount (accounts/app.ts) and downloadFintegraTransactions (accounts/sync.ts) are plain, only compacted copies of the Akahu versions, not reshaped to hide it.
